title: "pseudotime_prep_for_python"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "~/Alyssa/Single_Cell_CHIP_Vascular/")
library(tidyverse)
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratDisk)
```

```{r}
myeloid_merged_obj = readRDS("../Scale/rds_objects/11562-JVA/2_myeloid_merged_obj.rds")
epcs = readRDS("rds_objects/epcs/epcs.rds")
```

```{r}
epc_cells = colnames(epcs)
myeloid_merged_cells = colnames(myeloid_merged_obj)
myeloid_merged_obj@meta.data[epc_cells, "cell_type"] = "EPC"

mpp_data = subset(myeloid_merged_obj, subset = Set %in% c("MPP-AAVS", "MPP-TET2"))
```

```{r}
DefaultAssay(mpp_data) = "RNA"
mpp_data[["SCT"]] = NULL

mpp_data = SCTransform(mpp_data)
mpp_data = RunPCA(mpp_data, assay = "SCT")
mpp_data = RunUMAP(mpp_data, dims = 1:10)
```


```{r}
SaveH5Seurat(mpp_data, filename = "rds_objects/pseudotime/mpp.h5Seurat")
Convert("rds_objects/pseudotime/mpp.h5Seurat", dest = "h5ad")
```

```{r}
DefaultAssay(mpp_data) = "RNA"
mpp_data[["SCT"]] = NULL
SaveH5Seurat(mpp_data, filename = "rds_objects/pseudotime/mpp_no_sct.h5Seurat")
Convert("rds_objects/pseudotime/mpp_no_sct.h5Seurat", dest = "h5ad")
```
